home.heroTitle: Your hifz journey, in one place
home.heroSubtitle: Tmizan is a platform for memorizing and reviewing the Qur'an — track progress by page and ayah, get a personal plan, and stay connected with your muallim, wherever you are.
home.aboutP1: Tmizan is a web app for Muslims memorizing or reviewing the Qur'an. From beginner to hafiz — everyone gets one place to track progress, receive a personalized plan and stay in touch with their muallim.
home.aboutP2: Learning new material and reviewing what you know are always kept separate — the pedagogical foundation of the system, drawn from centuries of hifz tradition.
home.nameMeaning: Ta'lim (learning) + Mizan (balance) — knowledge that leads to harmony.
home.featuresSubtitle: Everything you need on the hifz journey — from the first page to the last ayah
home.f_tracker_desc: All 604 mushaf pages — status, confidence, mistakes and notes per page and per individual ayah, with translation and tafsir.
home.f_planner_desc: Choose what to learn, how much you can do daily and when you want to finish — the app computes a day-by-day plan to the estimated date.
home.f_murajaah_desc: Fifteen review methods: from classical (circles, a juz a day) to scientific (SRS) and the original Tmizan model with its fire zone.
home.f_mualim_desc: Your muallim tracks progress and mistakes, assigns tasks, schedules recitations — in person or online.
home.f_print_desc: A monthly plan with dates and fill-in fields — edit notes, print or save as PDF and keep your hifz on paper too.
home.f_test_desc: Test exactly the ayahs you know least, through the Bridge: previous ayah — blank — next ayah. Private, for your eyes only.
home.methodsSubtitle: Pick the method that suits you — or combine it with others
home.m20_desc: Ayah by ayah, each 20 times, then joined — the page is built in layers. The firmest memorization.
home.mFibonacci_desc: Each successful review pushes the next one further into the future. A mistake resets the sequence.
home.mKrugovi_desc: 20 circles of 30 pages — how hifz has been taught in Bosnia for centuries. Learning and review combined.
home.mSrs_desc: Spaced repetition: the better you know it, the less often you review. The brain remembers most efficiently.
home.mFemi_desc: Your entire hifz spread across the week, evenly each day — with automatic rebalancing.
home.mSeton_desc: Your whole hifz split into eight parts — one a day, a full cycle twice a week. An intensive method for advanced huffaz.
home.methodsMore: …and more: three-day, seven-day, mistake-based, new & old, halaqa, muallim's plan and others.
home.who_beginner_desc: We guide you step by step — from your first surah to your first juz, at your own pace.
home.who_hafiz_desc: Keep your entire hifz fresh with review cycles and a weak-spots map.
home.who_diaspora_desc: Far from your mosque? Tmizan keeps you connected to your muallim and halaqa — online.
home.mualimPitch: Whether you already have a muallim or are still looking for one, Tmizan is the right choice for you. Track your progress together with your local muallim, schedule recitation reviews, and keep a shared record on your path to becoming a hafiz.
home.quoteText: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
home.footerTagline: A hifz platform — knowledge that leads to balance.
home.badge: A platform for hifz and Qur'an review
home.videoSubtitle: A short walkthrough of the hifz & review platform.
